explanatory_first_jet_pencil.convention: Cartan I_(2k)=sum x_i^(2k), Pf4=product x_i; Euclidean Cartan metric. The split presentation changes this degree-six potential by an overall sign.
identities: -5 H_I4 grad P + 3 H_P grad I4 - 20 I2 grad P + 60 P grad I2 = 0
3 H_P grad Pf4 - 5 H_Pf4 grad P = 0
proof: Both displayed covector identities vanish coefficient by coefficient over QQ at the fixed potential.

These are equivariant polynomial covectors. At a regular semisimple Cartan point they are Cartan-valued; Cartan vanishing extends by conjugation and Zariski density to the full adjoint representation.
Pair with the first jet Y. Replace H_P Y by the first jet of grad P and P by its Euler contraction with grad P. This gives two relations among the original Jacobian generators and their first jets.
A quartic invariant has cubic gradient and quadratic Hessian. With the degree-five Jacobian relation and one first jet the base/jet degrees are (8,1), hence q=9.
explanatory_first_jet_pencil.scope: Exact rank drop of this six-source singlet pencil and two full-adjoint identities. Full first-discrepancy and absence of other rank changes require the separate complete arc comparisons.

jump_verification.genericity_scope: Complete first-discrepancy comparison at the fixed probe [1,2,3,4]. The explanatory six-source pencil has rank 6 over QQ(a,b,c,d), but no full parameter-field Hilbert series is claimed.
jump_verification.representation_of_difference: Two SO(8) singlets: only the zero Cartan weight changes, by two, in complete weight-space comparisons.

notes: Syzygy jump detected: q^9, base/jet [8, 1]. Jump + 2 target: q^11; current QQ Macdonald: q^10 inclusive.
